analyst.text: This is the first meeting since the summer trade that sent Miles Bridges to Phoenix and Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale to Charlotte. So far it looks lopsided toward the Hornets: Allen is shooting nearly 47% from three, while Bridges has a deeply negative net rating. Charlotte just snapped a six-game skid in Cleveland but are still without Brandon Miller, Dennis Schroder and Kon Knueppel, and this game opens a four-game road trip. Former-team motivation runs both ways, and the depleted roster leans this toward Phoenix.
